purpose: keep the way a team plans, delivers and improves healthy and consistent, so delivery is predictable and problems surface early
entry_criteria: Teams work in iterations or flow
procedure: Agree the few practices all teams share, such as definition of done, backlog refinement and review, and leave the rest to teams.
Track a small set of flow measures: cycle time, throughput, work in progress and escaped defects.
Read the measures with the teams as signals for conversation, not as targets for individuals.
Collect impediments from every team, and have an owner remove or escalate each in a stated time.
Check that retrospective actions are done, and that the same problem is not raised repeatedly without action.
Review the practices each quarter and drop ones that no longer help.
acceptance_criteria: Shared practices are few and written
Flow measures are tracked per team
Each impediment has an owner and date
Retrospective actions are tracked to done

validation.check: count open impediments older than the agreed time
check the last three retrospectives' actions for completion

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Cycle time rises from 4 to 9 days on one team. The log shows reviews waiting on one person; a review rota is agreed, and the cycle time is checked again in two sprints.
